issues.title: Overload stop has no reaction structure and its nut rubs the sliding piston
issues.evidence: review slide rows: piston blocked by FST_Stop_pin_R at 0.40 mm; pin+nut first hit PRT_fin_R_inboard at 0.75 mm; cad q inside x,122.6,0 x=153..201 -> no fin material; teardrop tip wall 1.34 mm (ray 152.9,110,0 -> 154.139); cad q dist FST_Stop_nut_R PRT_piston_R = -1.511 mm3; 08_head_open.png
issues.fix: Truncate the sleeve-bore teardrop at |x'| = 19.0 (9.5 mm flat roof, 6 mm wall to each face); pin hole O4.0 drilled through both closed halves; inboard cbore O8 x 3 deep; nut in a 7.2 AF x 3.6 hex pocket at x' 19.5-23.1 entered by a 7.2 slot from the split face; M4 x 45; distances rows pin-to-slot 0.15-0.35 and nut-to-piston >= 0.3; move to 50 kg cells so the 0.3 stop is a backstop.

issues.title: Sleeve friction hysteresis 0.37-1.1 x vertical hand load
issues.evidence: grip centre y229.5 (cad q list BUY_grip_R), sleeve 60 (bore y89.5-151), radial clearance 0.30 (dist piston/fin); factor (2*79.5+60)/60 = 3.65
issues.fix: Parallel-leaf flexure guide: two 30 x 20 x 1.2 PLA leaves printed flat, 40 apart (~45 N/mm vs cell ~1.5 kN/mm, 8 MPa at 12 N.m). Minimum: sleeve 100 mm (cell 40 mm forward, factor 2.6) + PTFE tape; prismatic joint +-0.5 with fits min 0.2.

issues.title: Lost motion piston-cell and an uncontrolled stop gap
issues.evidence: distances row piston/cell 0.201 (FAIL vs <=0.05); rear nut y96.2-100.4 in pocket y96-101 (0.8 play); README step 4 back-off 0-0.2 mm; pin +-0.5 in O8 cbore; stack 0.3 +- 0.85 -> -0.55..+1.15
issues.fix: Pocket 4.3 deep for the 4.2 nut; seat the piston face by tightening, clock the stop with a 6-position slot or a drilled-through round hole (+-0.1); stacks row 'stop gap' between 0.15-0.45.

issues.title: Stop nut can't be fitted as written: no pocket, falls into the bore when the outboard half is turned over, binds the piston when snugged
issues.evidence: nut pocket box lies inside the teardrop void (inside probes); nut x194.0-197.2 at the bolt tip overlaps piston -1.511 mm3
issues.fix: Hex pocket 7.2 AF x 3.6 with a split-face slot (as rank 1), nut held with a drop of hot glue.

issues.title: Hex socket caps vs the lab's hex head stock
issues.evidence: BOM/manifest: M4_cap x16 (6), x40 (2), M5_cap (6); M4 cbore O8.0 (< M4 hex head 8.08 across corners); lower M5 spot face O11 (< 8 mm socket OD ~12); README hardware table still 'M8 button heads'
issues.fix: Confirm stock; for external hex use M4 cbores O12 and M5 spot faces O14; fix the README table.

issues.title: Teardrop tips show as open wedge notches on the lip face; 1.24-1.34 mm skin over them on both fin faces
issues.fix: End the teardrop 4 mm short of the lip with a round O33.6 bore; truncation at |x'| = 19 (rank 1) gives 6 mm skin.

issues.title: Pistons need supports under 130 mm of spigot; 821 mm2 body overhang missed by printcheck
